Definition: Gera, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Gera is a person named 9 times in Scripture, in Genesis, Judges, and 2 Samuel. The full story lives on the Gera profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Gera in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
